text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm stopping by a fast-food<n>restaurant for lunch,
when...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya got sixty minutes! Show 'em<n>whatcha got, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I got this in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri is just about to take on the<n>Super
Humongous Burger Challenge.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The burger is free if she can finish it<n>within sixty
minutes. Plus, she'll get a<n>coupon to use the next
time she<n>comes here! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And a real sweet coupon at that! It'll<n>keep her fed
for a month!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sorry, I've got a call from the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What? We didn't send in part of the<n>race
application? Y-you need me to<n>come back now?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Say what?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...H-how can I possibly leave thatbehind?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following Oguri Cap's gaze, I get an<n>eyeful of a
towering burger boasting<n>layer upon layer of
fillings...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I feel ya, but that paper's got a<n>deadline. You might
not turn it in on<n>time unless you hurry!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I must, then... Creek! I want you... to<n>take on the
challenge in my place!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, er... Me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And then give the coupon... to Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri?! Ya can't mean that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'm sorry, but there's no way I<n>can do this on
my own...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's all good, Oguri. I 'preciate the<n>gesture!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hrk... This... This hurts...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three friends work<n>together to lug the
giant burger with<n>them back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I don't want to let the two<n>of you down...
Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I owe you one!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You guys are the best! Gahhh, I'm<n>the happiest
Umamusume in the<n>world!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While Super Creek manages to<n>complete the
challenge, the excessive<n>volume of food leaves her
immobilized for a while.
